title: Pan-Seared Rainbow Trout with French Feuille
description: A flavorful and visually appealing dish featuring seared rainbow trout paired with the delicate taste of French feuille.

ingredients.name: French feuille
ingredients.notes: Frozen is fine, thaw according to package

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.notes: For searing trout and brushing feuille

instructions: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear trout for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Transfer skillet to preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes, until cooked through.
Meanwhile, brush French feuille with olive oil and place on a baking sheet.
Bake feuille in the oven for 3-5 minutes, until puffed and lightly browned.
Top feuille with halved lacquered cherry tomatoes, minced garlic, and chopped parsley.
Serve trout atop French feuille with the cherry tomato and parsley mixture on top.
